Modifications from upstream:
  - Stripped XML/pin, tab-file, CLI, and protein-inference code
  - Wrapped all vendored declarations in OpenMS::Internal::Percolator::
  - Replaced Logger.h with a shim that routes through OpenMS's OPENMS_LOG_*
  - Removed CMake-generated config.h / Version.h in favor of in-tree stubs
  - Added constructor extension on DataSet to accept externally-supplied
    cross-validation grouping keys (for domain-agnostic use)

Embedded SVMlin files (ssl.h, ssl.cpp, Timer.h, Timer.cpp):
  Copyright (c) 2006 Vikas Sindhwani, University of Chicago.
  Adapted to Percolator by Lukas Käll, University of Washington.
  Speedup by John Halloran, UC Davis (J. Proteome Res. 2018, 17:5, 1978-1982).

  The OpenMS maintainers obtained explicit relicensing of SVMlin for use
  within OpenMS under Apache-2.0-compatible terms prior to inclusion.
